title: auto-set USER/LOGNAME for jobs (Keychain access)
description:
Jobs run under launchd bare env, where USER/LOGNAME are unset. Tools that read the macOS login Keychain (e.g. `claude -p` reading its subscription token) need them - without USER/LOGNAME, claude fails with "Not logged in - Please run /login".

This cost the most debugging time during the magpie integration. The magpie bin/scan wrapper currently works around it by setting USER/LOGNAME itself via `id -un`.

Proposal: beagle sets USER/LOGNAME in every job environment automatically (it already injects HOME-adjacent context and BEAGLE_* vars). Failing that, document the gotcha for jobs that shell out to claude or other keychain-backed tools.
creator: Alexander Terp
